title: Accounting Executive II
jobDescription: Are you a detail-oriented and proactive accounting professional passionate about ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence? We are looking for an Accounting Executive II who will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting statutory compliance, and enabling timely financial reporting while collaborating with cross-functional teams. 7EDGE is a Digital Product Engineering Company based in Bengaluru, India. Our core expertise lies in crafting modern applications with cloud-native services, specializing in microservices and serverless architecture tailored to the requirements of enterprises and startups alike. We deliver unparalleled solutions to industries and companies across the globe. As the company is expanding rapidly, we are looking to grow our Finance team by hiring talented individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to our success. In this role, you will leverage your accounting expertise, analytical skills, and attention to detail to: Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), including invoice processing, vendor payments, customer collections, and reconciliations. Maintain accurate books of accounts by performing bank, credit card, vendor, customer, and general ledger reconciliations. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities, including journal entries, accruals, provisions, and reconciliation of ledger balances. Prepare financial schedules, management information system (MIS) reports, cash flow reports, profitability reports, budgeting inputs, forecasting data, and variance analysis. Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, including GST, TDS, direct taxes, indirect taxes, and other applicable regulatory requirements. Assist in statutory, tax, and internal audits by preparing schedules, maintaining audit-ready documentation, and coordinating with auditors. Maintain strong internal controls while identifying opportunities to improve accounting processes and operational efficiency. Collaborate with Finance, People Operations, Workplace Operations, and other business teams to provide timely and accurate financial information. RESPONSIBILITIES Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes, including invoice processing, payments, collections, and ledger maintenance. Perform bank, vendor, customer, balance sheet, credit card, and i while resolving outstanding differences. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities through timely journal entries, accruals, provisions, and reconciliations. Prepare financial schedules, MIS reports, management reports, profitability analysis, cash flow reports, budgeting support, forecasting inputs, and variance analysis. Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, direct taxes, indirect taxes, labour law compliances, and other statutory regulations. Support statutory, tax, and internal audits by preparing documentation, responding to audit queries, and maintaining audit-ready records. Maintain accounting records in ERP systems while ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial data. Develop and improve financial reports, reconciliation templates, and accounting workflows using Microsoft Excel and ERP capabilities. Support process improvements, internal controls, and automation initiatives to enhance finance operations. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to provide timely financial information and support business reporting requirements. REPORTING LINE You will be reporting to the Principal Accounting Executive – Finance. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or Master's degree in Commerce (M.Com). 4–5 years of experience in core accounting. Strong understanding of accounting principles and Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS). Hands-on experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger accounting, and account reconciliations. Experience in month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities. Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow, management reporting (MIS), financial schedules, budgeting support, forecasting, and variance analysis. Experience handling statutory compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax, labour law compliances, and statutory audits. Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as Tally or Zoho Books. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including logical functions, Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, financial reporting, reconciliations, and large dataset analysis. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. High attention to detail, ownership, integrity, and commitment to maintaining confidentiality. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Exposure to ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle NetSuite. Experience supporting, internal and tax audits. Experience preparing management reports (MIS), financial dashboards, budgeting, and forecasting reports. Familiarity with accounting automation tools, Excel macros, or workflow automation. Experience implementing accounting process improvements or internal control enhancements. Prior experience in IT/ITES, Consulting, Shared Services, Professional Services, or Audit firms. Passion for digital finance tools, accounting automation, and continuous process improvement. PERKS/BENEFITS Personalized learning opportunities to enhance your career. Competitive salary structure aligned with industry standards. Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs. A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued. Regular team-building events, company outings, and engaging workplace activities. A culture of appreciation with Peer and Spot Recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

title: Executive II, Marketing Operations
jobDescription: JOB DESCRIPTION Are you a passionate and results-driven professional eager to build scalable marketing systems and drive predictable pipeline growth? We are looking for an Executive II, Marketing Operations, responsible for owning marketing operations, demand generation systems, outbound campaigns, and alliance programs that convert demand into qualified opportunities. 7EDGE is a Digital Product Engineering Company based in Bengaluru, India. Our core expertise lies in crafting modern applications with cloud-native services, specializing in microservices and serverless architecture tailored to the requirements of enterprises and startups alike. We deliver unparalleled solutions to industries and companies across the globe. As the company is expanding rapidly, we are looking to grow our Marketing Operations team by hiring talented individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to our success. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise and problem-solving skills to: Build and execute intent-based outbound campaigns aligned to approved customer segments. Design and optimize lead nurture workflows that move prospects through the funnel. Own HubSpot CRM architecture, lifecycle management, lead scoring, workflow automation, and pipeline governance. Execute Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives and measure campaign performance. Manage alliance and partner relationships across cloud ecosystems and referral channels. Drive marketing performance visibility through reporting, analytics, and optimization initiatives. This role presents a valuable opportunity to apply your expertise in marketing operations and demand generation while contributing directly to pipeline growth and the evolution of 7EDGE's marketing function. If you are ready to take on this dynamic and fulfilling position, we encourage you to submit your application. RESPONSIBILITIES Build and execute intent-based outbound campaigns by identifying market signals, mapping target segments, and activating campaigns across channels. Plan and execute cold email campaigns, including list building, copywriting, sequencing, send execution, and reply handling. Design and maintain nurture workflows, lifecycle stage logic, trigger conditions, and content mapping across the buyer journey. Execute Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives, including target account identification, campaign planning, and multi-channel orchestration. Own and expand customer referral programs while identifying and onboarding local partners, agents, and tender opportunities. Respond to, qualify, and progress inbound partnership opportunities and alliance relationships. Manage cloud partner portal operations, including milestone tracking, competency submissions, and program documentation across AWS, GCP, Azure, and partner ecosystems. Design and maintain HubSpot lifecycle stages, lead scoring frameworks, workflow automation, pipeline structures, and CRM governance processes. Track campaign spend and cost-per-lead (CPL) performance against defined targets and review weekly dashboards. Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports covering lead volume, MQLs, SQLs, channel contribution, and campaign effectiveness. REPORTING LINE You will be reporting to the Marketing Manager, Marketing Team BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3–5 years of experience in B2B Marketing, Growth Marketing, Demand Generation, or Marketing Operations roles. Bachelor's degree in a related field. Demonstrated experience owning intent based outbound campaigns, ABM initiatives, CRM operations, and lead generation programs. Email marketing and newsletter execution, including list building, copywriting, sequencing, send execution, and reply handling. Nurture workflow design, trigger condition management, lifecycle logic, and content mapping. Experience using HubSpot Marketing Hub and outbound sequencing tools such as Apollo, ReachInbox, Instantly, Clay, or similar platforms. PREFERRED QUALIFICATION Experience with cloud partner programs such as AWS Partner Network, GCP Partner Advantage, Azure Partner Center, or similar ecosystems. Experience managing alliance partnerships, referral networks, and local agent programs. Familiarity with intent data platforms such as Clay, Bombora, or equivalent tools. Partner negotiation and onboarding experience. Basic project coordination experience across multiple marketing initiatives. Experience working with cloud providers and cloud ecosystem programs. Experience within B2B technology services, cloud, digital engineering, IT services, or B2B marketing agency environments. PERKS/BENEFITS Personalized learning opportunities to enhance your career. Competitive salary structure aligned with industry standards. Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs. A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued. Regular team-building events, company outings, and engaging workplace activities. A culture of appreciation with Peer and Spot Recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

title: Senior Market Development Representative
jobDescription: JOB DESCRIPTION Are you a passionate, resilient, and results-driven professional who thrives on building relationships, generating opportunities, and driving business growth? We are looking for a Senior Market Development Representative (MDR) responsible for building and scaling outbound demand generation initiatives while driving qualified pipeline growth through strategic outreach and partner engagement. 7EDGE is a Digital Product Engineering Company based in Bengaluru, India. Our core expertise lies in crafting modern applications with cloud-native services, specializing in microservices and serverless architecture tailored to the requirements of enterprises and startups alike. We deliver unparalleled solutions to industries and companies across the globe. As the company is expanding rapidly, we are looking to grow our Marketing by hiring talented individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to our success. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise and problem-solving skills to: Drive structured outbound prospecting initiatives targeting decision-makers across approved customer segments. Convert marketing-generated interest into qualified meetings and sales opportunities. Build and execute telemarketing and outreach cadences across multiple channels. Develop and manage local agents, referral partners, and affiliate relationships. Coordinate with AWS Account Managers and Partner Success Managers to drive pipeline opportunities. Own CRM hygiene and maintain accurate reporting and pipeline visibility. Contribute toward building and scaling 7EDGE's demand generation engine. This role presents a valuable opportunity to contribute directly to 7EDGE's growth journey and take ownership of building scalable demand generation initiatives. If you are ready to take on this dynamic and fulfilling position, we encourage you to submit your application.. RESPONSIBILITIES Execute structured telemarketing and relationship based cold-calling campaigns targeting decision-makers across approved customer segments. Qualify prospects and hand over confirmed meetings to Sales through HubSpot. Design and execute intent-based email campaigns, cold email sequences, and lead nurturing workflows. Identify, onboard, and manage local agents, affiliates, and referral partners. Coordinate with AWS Account Managers and Partner Success Managers for market-specific prospecting activities. Capture and follow up on all leads generated through events & exhibitions within 48 hours. Maintain CRM data accuracy and ensure pipeline hygiene in HubSpot. Handle objections effectively and qualify prospects using MQL/SQL criteria. Track outreach performance and continuously optimize conversion metrics. Build strong external relationships with customers, partners, and stakeholders. REPORTING LINE You will be reporting to the Manager I – Services Marketing BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of experience in B2B outbound sales, SDR, MDR, Inside Sales, or related roles. Prior experience within Digital Services, IT Services, Technology, Cloud, or B2B SaaS environments. Hands-on experience in telemarketing, cold calling, and structured outbound outreach. Strong understanding of lead qualification methodologies (MQL/SQL). Proven experience using HubSpot CRM for lead management and pipeline tracking. Experience with outreach tools such as Apollo, Outreach, ReachInbox, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Exposure to the North America and Western Europe markets. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage EST/GMT time-zone-based outreach activities. Excellent objection handling and relationship-building capabilities. PREFERRED QUALIFICATION Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP partner ecosystems and co-sell models. Experience managing referral networks, affiliates, or partner ecosystems. Knowledge of campaign attribution and UTM tracking fundamentals. Familiarity with AI-assisted outreach tools and personalization platforms. Prior experience managing or mentoring small teams. PERKS/BENEFITS Personalized learning opportunities to enhance your career. Competitive salary structure aligned with industry standards. Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs. A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued. Regular team-building events, company outings, and engaging workplace activities. A culture of appreciation with Peer and Spot Recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.
